about: Storybook cutscenes for Seven Steps (design/story/cutscenes.md; user request 2026-11-12 evening, overrides the old no-cutscene rule). ko base + text[] per language like story.json. Each page = one picture (image key -> StoryImageSet, art in Assets/Shared/Art/Story/Cutscenes/<key>.png) + 1-3 lines. 'rule' (optional) is the plain-language rule caption shown under the story lines (2026-11-13 user request). 'art' is the Codex prompt for that page, not shown in game.
artStyle: Picture-book illustration, gouache and watercolour on textured paper, soft warm light, muted palette (moss greens, warm sandstone, deep indigo night sky). Three identical small faceless hooded wanderers of the same height, told apart only by scarf colour: teal #568C88 (eldest), ochre #B99A57 (middle), terracotta #B96C59 (youngest). Standing stones are plain neutral grey granite. Seven stars in a dipper shape may appear in the sky. No text, letters, numbers, star ratings or UI in the picture; no real-world ruins, religions or symbols. 16:9, 1920x1080; keep the bottom quarter calm and low-detail (the text box sits there).

lines.line: 고향 하늘의 일곱 별은 국자 모양으로 떠 있다.

text.line: The seven stars over home hang in the shape of a dipper.

lines.line: 별마다 작은 행성이 있고 고향은 첫 별 아래다.

text.line: Under each star lies one small planet; home lies under the first.

lines.line: 그 별들이 해마다 흐려지고 고향의 문도 닫혀 간다.

text.line: Year by year the stars grow fainter, and the gates of home are closing.

pages.art: Night over a small mossy home planet. Wide shot: the three hooded brothers stand small on a mossy hill beside broken observatory pillars, looking up at a faint, half-faded seven-star dipper. A shut stone gate in the moss below them.

rule.line: 별이 흐려지면 그 아래 땅은 저마다 다르게 걸음을 잊는다.

text.line: When a star fades, the ground beneath it forgets our steps, each planet in its own way.

lines.line: 관측소 마지막 문 너머에서 옛 관측자의 별지도를 찾았다.

text.line: Beyond the observatory's last door we found the old watchers' star map.

lines.line: 별은 국자에 넷, 자루에 셋. 자루 끝 아래엔 선돌의 원.

text.line: Four stars in the bowl, three in the handle, the ring of stones under the handle's tip.

lines.line: 지도는 같은 밤에 태어난 우리 셋의 손에서만 빛났다.

text.line: It shone only in our hands, the three born on the same night.

pages.art: Inside a ruined mossy observatory, lit by the map itself. Close-medium shot: the three brothers kneel around an unrolled scroll that glows softly. On it: seven star points and a small ring of stones at one edge, with no lines between the stars yet. Their three scarves hang into the glow.

rule.line: 옛 관측자는 먼 옛날 일곱 행성을 걸으며 별을 이은 사람들이다.

text.line: The old watchers walked the seven planets long ago and joined the stars.

lines.line: 한 걸음마다 하늘에 별이 하나씩 켜진다.

text.line: Each step lights one star in the sky.

lines.line: 일곱째 별이 켜질 때에만 땅이 귀를 기울인다.

text.line: Only when the seventh lights does the ground listen.

pages.art: Side view: the middle brother (ochre scarf) walks across square mossy stone tiles carrying the scroll. Behind him, small glowing star-shaped footprints on the tiles he has stepped on. Above him the dipper is half lit: the first stars bright, the rest still dim.

rule.line: 그래서 우리는 저마다 꼭 일곱 걸음씩 걷는다.

text.line: So each of us walks exactly seven steps.

lines.line: 일곱째 걸음이 닿는 곳에서만 땅이 움직인다.

text.line: The ground moves only where the seventh step lands.

lines.line: 여섯째 걸음에 문 앞에 서도 문은 열리지 않는다.

text.line: Stand at the door on the sixth step and it stays shut.

lines.line: 일곱 걸음을 꼭 맞게 세어야 한다.

text.line: You must count exactly seven steps, no more, no less.

pages.art: The youngest brother (terracotta scarf) sets his foot on a glowing star mark in front of a mossy stone gate, and the gate swings open with warm light. Above, the whole dipper is lit and a thin beam of starlight runs straight down to his step (the alignment).

rule.line: 앞의 여섯 걸음은 땅이 듣지 못하고 일곱째가 닿은 곳만 깨어난다.

text.line: The ground cannot hear the first six; only the spot where the seventh lands wakes up.

lines.line: 일곱 걸음을 다 쓰면 지도를 다음 형제에게 넘긴다.

text.line: When the seven steps are spent, the map goes to the next brother.

lines.line: 남기로 하면 그 자리에서 선돌이 되어 길을 붙든다.

text.line: Whoever chooses to stay turns into a standing stone and holds the way.

lines.line: 그러면 다음 형제는 처음 출발한 자리에서 깨어난다.

text.line: Then the next brother wakes where we first set out.

pages.art: Split composition in one scene: on the right, the eldest (teal scarf) stands still on a stone plate beside an open gate, his lower half already turning into a plain grey granite standing stone. A ribbon of starlight carries the scroll from him to the left, where the middle brother wakes up curled in a soft pool of starlight at the starting point.

rule.line: 형이 KEEP으로 남아 돌이 되면 나는 처음 출발한 자리에서 눈을 뜬다.

text.line: If my brother chooses KEEP and turns to stone, I open my eyes back where we set out.

lines.line: 남지 않고 지도만 건넬 수도 있다.

text.line: Or he can hand on the map without staying.

lines.line: 돌은 남지 않고 다음 형제가 바로 그 자리에서 깨어난다.

text.line: Then no stone is left, and the next brother wakes right on that spot.

rule.line: SWITCH로 지도만 건네면 돌 없이 나는 형이 섰던 자리에서 깬다.

text.line: If he SWITCHes and only hands on the map, no stone stays, and I wake where he stood.

pages.art: Same mossy stone-tile board as the previous page, medium shot. In the middle of the board the eldest brother (teal scarf) calmly turns into a light ribbon of starlight drifting up toward the dipper (gentle, not sad), leaving no stone on his tile; on that very same tile the middle brother (ochre scarf) is waking up in a soft pool of starlight, already holding the scroll. Far behind them, the original starting tile glows only faintly. No standing stone anywhere in this picture.

lines.line: 별 사이의 선은 한 사람의 걸음으로는 다 이어지지 않는다.

text.line: One walker alone cannot join the whole line between two stars.

lines.line: 셋이 모두 걸어야 선이 가장 밝게 이어진다.

text.line: It shines brightest only when all three of us walk it.

lines.line: 닿으면 별 하나, 풀이를 안 보면 둘, 셋이 걸으면 셋.

text.line: Arrive: one star. No solution viewed: two. All three walk: three.

pages.art: Top-down-ish view of a small board of stone tiles: three trails of glowing footprints, one teal, one ochre, one terracotta, each starting from the same start and meeting at the exit, where the three brothers stand together. In the sky above, a bright line between two stars, woven from three coloured strands (teal, ochre, terracotta).

rule.line: 그러니 누구도 빠지지 말자. 셋이 함께 걸어야 별 셋이 켜진다.

text.line: So let's leave no one out. Three stars light only when all three of us walk.

lines.line: 별 아래 행성을 차례로 걸어 별을 하나씩 다시 켠다.

text.line: We will walk the planets in order and light their stars again, one by one.

lines.line: 별이 켜지면 지도에 다음 행성으로 가는 선이 생긴다.

text.line: Each star we light draws the line on the map to the next planet.

lines.line: 끝은 자루 끝 별 아래, 선돌의 원이다.

text.line: The end is the ring of stones under the handle's last star.

pages.art: Back view, wide: the three brothers walk away along a mossy path toward the horizon of their small planet, the scroll on the youngest's back. In the deep indigo sky the faint dipper, and far away a tiny planet crowned by a ring of standing stones.

rule.line: 국자는 움직이지 않는 별을 돈다. 한 번 다 돌면 한 바퀴다.

text.line: The dipper circles the still star; one full circle is called a turn.

lines.line: 이제 우리는 별 곁에서 일곱 행성을 내려다본다.

text.line: Now we watch the seven planets from beside the stars.

lines.line: 이끼엔 발자국이, 구멍엔 다리가, 얼음엔 별빛이 돌아왔다.

text.line: Footprints on the moss, bridges over the holes, starlight on the ice: all came back.

pages.art: The three brothers back beside the stars, looking down at the seven healed planets (Codex Style A, 2026-11-14 ending set).

lines.line: 셋이 함께 걸은 길마다 별이 밝게 남았다.

text.line: Every path the three of us walked together stayed bright.

lines.line: 이제 다음 바퀴에 지도를 건넬 이는 우리다.

text.line: Now we are the ones who will hand on the map next turn.

lines.line: 다음 바퀴에도, 일곱 걸음씩.

text.line: Next turn too, seven steps at a time.

pages.art: Night above the ring of standing stones, seen from behind three small figures sitting together on the grass. The whole dipper is bright, and lines of three woven colours (teal, ochre, terracotta) run between its stars across the sky.

lines.line: 첫째 별 아래, 이끼의 궤도. 우리 고향이다.

text.line: Under the first star: Mossy Orbit, our home.

lines.line: 별이 흐려지자 아무도 걷지 않았고 길마다 이끼가 덮였다.

text.line: When its star dimmed, no one walked anymore, and moss covered every path.

lines.line: 옛 관측자가 남긴 발판과 문을 지나 첫 별을 다시 켜자.

text.line: Past the plates and doors the old watchers left, we will light the first star again.

pages.art: No new picture: reuses cutscene.interlude.moss.2 (the place, before the brothers walk it).

rule.line: 발판 위에 누가 머무는 동안만 문이 열린다.

text.line: A door stays open only while someone stands on its plate.

lines.line: 둘째 별 아래, 별구멍 달.

text.line: Under the second star: Starhole Moon.

lines.line: 별이 꺼져 가자 땅이 제자리를 잊고 내려앉아 구멍이 났다.

text.line: As its star faded, the ground forgot its place and sank, leaving holes.

lines.line: 떨어진 이도 하늘이 맞춰지면 돌아오지만 길은 이어야 한다.

text.line: Whoever falls comes back when the sky lines up, but we must keep the path whole.

pages.art: No new picture: reuses cutscene.interlude.hollow.2 (the place, before the brothers walk it).

rule.line: 일곱째 걸음이 구멍에 닿으면 그 형제가 다리가 된다.

text.line: If the seventh step lands on a hole, that brother becomes a bridge.

lines.line: 셋째 별 아래, 새김돌 행성.

text.line: Under the third star: Carved Stone World.

lines.line: 별이 흐려져 아무도 걸음을 세지 못하게 되자

text.line: When its star dimmed and no one could count their steps,

lines.line: 옛 관측자가 기둥마다 셈을 새겨 두었다.

text.line: the old watchers carved the counts into every pillar.

pages.art: No new picture: reuses cutscene.interlude.carved.2 (the place, before the brothers walk it).

rule.line: 숫자 문은 새겨진 숫자째 걸음에만 열린다.

text.line: A numbered gate opens only on the step that matches its number.

lines.line: 넷째 별 아래, 서리 위성.

text.line: Under the fourth star: Frost Moon.

lines.line: 별이 가장 먼저 완전히 꺼져 별빛 없이 얼어붙었다.

text.line: Its star was the first to go out completely, and the moon froze without starlight.

lines.line: 얼음 위에선 무언가에 부딪힐 때까지 미끄러진다.

text.line: On the ice we slide until something stops us.

pages.art: No new picture: reuses cutscene.interlude.frost.1 (the place, before the brothers walk it).

rule.line: 옛 관측자는 얼음 위에 선돌을 세워 미끄러지는 걸음을 붙잡았다.

text.line: The old watchers raised stones on the ice to catch sliding steps.

lines.line: 다섯째 별 아래, 결구의 행성.

text.line: Under the fifth star: Joinery World.

lines.line: 별이 길을 열지 못하자 옛 관측자가 장치를 만들었다.

text.line: When its star could no longer open the ways, the old watchers built machines.

lines.line: 레버는 모두 꼭 우리 손 높이에 있었다.

text.line: Every lever sat right at the height of our hands.

pages.art: No new picture: reuses cutscene.interlude.joinery.2 (the place, before the brothers walk it).

rule.line: 레버를 당기면 한쪽 벽이 열리고 다른 쪽 벽이 닫힌다.

text.line: Pull a lever and one wall opens while another closes.

lines.line: 여섯째 별 아래, 무너지는 행성.

text.line: Under the sixth star: Crumbling World.

lines.line: 별이 거의 꺼져서 땅이 디딘 걸음을 곧바로 잊는다.

text.line: Its star is nearly gone, so the ground forgets each step at once.

lines.line: 금 간 바닥은 한 번만 버티고 지나가면 무너진다.

text.line: Cracked floor holds only once, then falls away behind us.

pages.art: No new picture: reuses cutscene.interlude.crumble.1 (the place, before the brothers walk it).

rule.line: 옛 관측자는 선돌의 수를 세는 문을 세워 머문 이를 기억하게 했다.

text.line: The old watchers built gates that count the stones, so the ground remembers who stayed.

lines.line: 일곱째 별 아래, 원형 제단.

text.line: Under the seventh star: The Stone Circle.

lines.line: 바퀴마다 모든 행성의 물과 이끼가 흘러와 늪이 되었다.

text.line: Every turn, the water and moss of all the planets ran down here and became the bog.

lines.line: 잊힌 걸음이 쌓인 늪에선 한 걸음이 두 걸음만큼 무겁다.

text.line: In a bog heavy with forgotten steps, one step weighs as much as two.

pages.art: No new picture: reuses cutscene.interlude.altar.1 (the place, before the brothers walk it).

rule.line: 진흙에 디디면 걸음이 둘 든다.

text.line: Stepping into mud costs two steps.

lines.line: 이끼의 궤도를 끝까지 걸었다.

text.line: We walked Mossy Orbit to the end.

lines.line: 고향의 이끼 길에 다시 발자국이 났다.

text.line: Footprints marked the mossy paths of home again.

pages.art: The three brothers look back from the edge of the home planet at the mossy observatory far behind them. Its round stone floor plates and old worn footpaths glow faintly in the moss where long-ago walkers once stood and went. Gentle, a little wistful.

lines.line: 형이 발판 위에 선돌로 남으니 문이 열렸다.

text.line: My brother stayed on the plate as a standing stone, and the door stood open.

lines.line: 누군가 머물러 주어야 길이 열린다는 걸 배웠다.

text.line: We learned that a way opens only when someone stays behind to hold it.

pages.art: Inside the mossy home observatory among cut pillars. The eldest brother (teal scarf) stands on a round stone floor plate, half turned into a plain grey standing stone in his own hooded shape; beside him a stone door stands open, held by his weight. The other two brothers walk through the open door, looking back at him gratefully.

rule.line: 국자의 첫 별이 다시 켜졌다. 일곱 중 하나.

text.line: The first star of the bowl is lit again: one of seven.

lines.line: 켜진 별이 지도에 다음 선을 그었다.

text.line: The relit star drew the next line on the map.

lines.line: 선 끝 둘째 별 아래엔 땅이 꺼진 구멍투성이 달이 있다.

text.line: At its end, under the second star, hangs a moon whose ground has sunk into holes.

lines.line: 그 별도 흐려지고 있다. 서둘러야 한다.

text.line: That star is dimming too. We must hurry.

pages.art: Past the observatory's last open door, the three brothers kneel at a round hole in the mossy stone floor; stars glow far below through it. The youngest (terracotta scarf) holds the glowing scroll, where one bright line now joins the first star to the second. Through the doorway, low in the indigo sky, a pale small moon pierced with round holes.

lines.line: 별구멍 달의 구멍마다 다리를 놓았다.

text.line: We bridged the holes of Starhole Moon.

lines.line: 옛 관측자도 일곱째 걸음으로 이 구멍들을 메웠다.

text.line: The old watchers once filled these holes with a seventh step too.

pages.art: Cut-away side view of the hollow moon: a thin crust with round holes, and under it a deep space full of soft stars that hold up the path of stone tiles from below. Through one hole the eldest brother (teal scarf) floats gently back up on a column of starlight to the two brothers waiting at its rim.

lines.line: 일곱째 걸음이 구멍에 닿자 형이 누워 다리가 되었다.

text.line: When the seventh step landed on a hole, my brother lay down and became a bridge.

lines.line: 언제 딛느냐가 전부라는 걸 배웠다.

text.line: We learned that timing is everything.

pages.art: On the pale starhole moon: the middle brother (ochre scarf) lies across a round hole as a calm bridge of grey stone and soft starlight, and the youngest walks over him carefully with the scroll. Stars glow deep inside the hole beneath. Other holes dot the moon around them.

rule.line: 국자의 둘째 별이 다시 켜졌다. 일곱 중 둘.

text.line: The second star of the bowl is lit again: two of seven.

lines.line: 새 선은 가장 깊은 구멍 아래로 이어졌다.

text.line: The new line ran down through the deepest hole.

lines.line: 셋째 별 아래, 기둥마다 숫자가 새겨진 행성이 보인다.

text.line: Under the third star we saw a planet with numbers carved on every pillar.

lines.line: 거기선 몇째 걸음인지를 돌이 묻는다.

text.line: There, the stones ask which step you are on.

pages.art: The three brothers kneel at the rim of the largest hole and look down through it. Far below, framed by the hole, a sandstone planet covered in a forest of tall pillars, each carved with simple notches (no real numerals or letters).

lines.line: 새김돌 행성의 숫자를 모두 읽었다.

text.line: We read every number on Carved Stone World.

lines.line: 나는 옛 숫자 옆에 우리 점 하나를 새겼다.

text.line: Beside the old numbers, I carved one dot of our own.

pages.art: Close view: the youngest brother (terracotta scarf) presses a small round dot into the soft sandstone of a pillar, just beside rows of old worn notches. His brothers watch over his shoulders. The new dot glows faintly terracotta.

lines.line: 서두르지도 늦지도 않게 세어 숫자 문을 지났다.

text.line: Neither early nor late, we counted our way through the numbered gates.

lines.line: 옛 관측자도 우리처럼 세며 걷던 사람들이었다.

text.line: The old watchers were walkers like us, who counted as they went.

pages.art: Among tall sandstone pillars carved with notches, the middle brother (ochre scarf) steps through a stone gate carved with a row of notches; a small star mark glows under his foot as the gate opens, matching the notches. Nearby, one person-high plain grey standing stone stands alone. Late warm light, long shadows.

rule.line: 국자의 셋째 별이 다시 켜졌다. 일곱 중 셋.

text.line: The third star of the bowl is lit again: three of seven.

lines.line: 새 선은 서리 덮인 마지막 기둥 너머로 이어졌다.

text.line: The new line ran past the last pillar, white with frost.

lines.line: 넷째 별 아래, 별빛 없이 얼어붙은 푸른 달이 있다.

text.line: Under the fourth star hangs a blue moon frozen without starlight.

lines.line: 거기선 세기 전에 발이 미끄러진다.

text.line: There, your feet slide before you can count.

pages.art: Wide dusk view: the last and tallest carved pillar, its notches hidden under white frost, with a thin trail of frost crystals drifting up from it toward a small cold blue moon in the indigo sky. The three brothers stand at its foot, breath misting, the scroll on the eldest's back.

lines.line: 서리 위성의 얼음 길을 다 지나왔다.

text.line: We made it across the ice of Frost Moon.

lines.line: 멈춰야 할 곳마다 서로의 돌이 있었다.

text.line: Wherever we needed to stop, one of our stones was there.

pages.art: A frozen moon with frosted stone tiles and wooden rails. The middle brother slides across shining ice and comes to a gentle stop against a plain grey standing stone in the shape of a hooded brother; the third brother watches from the start. Cold blues with warm scarf colours.

lines.line: 형이 남긴 돌이 벽이 되어 나를 세워 주었다.

text.line: The stone my brother left became the wall that stopped me.

lines.line: 국자의 넷째 별이 켜지자 국자가 닫혔다.

text.line: When the fourth star lit, the bowl closed.

lines.line: 고향 하늘이 조금 밝아졌다. 일곱 중 넷.

text.line: The sky over home grew a little brighter: four of seven.

pages.art: Night sky over the frost moon: the dipper's four bowl stars are now joined in a closed, bright four-sided shape, while the three handle stars are still faint. Far away, a tiny mossy home planet glows a little warmer. The three brothers sit together on the ice, looking up.

rule.line: 별 넷이 돌아오자 닫혀 가던 고향의 문 하나가 다시 열렸다.

text.line: With four stars back, one of the closing gates of home opened again.

lines.line: 새 선은 자루의 첫 별로 뻗었다.

text.line: The new line reached out to the first star of the handle.

lines.line: 얼음 속 놋쇠 쐐기에서 톱니 도는 소리가 들렸다.

text.line: From a brass wedge in the ice we heard gears turning.

lines.line: 다섯째 별 아래, 장치가 벽을 움직이는 행성이다.

text.line: Under the fifth star, machines move the walls.

pages.art: Close view: the eldest brother (teal scarf) holds up a small worn brass wedge just freed from clear ice, the other two leaning in to listen. Reflected in the brass, a distant planet of timber beams, brass gears, levers and moving wooden walls.

lines.line: 결구의 행성에서 장치를 모두 돌렸다.

text.line: We worked every machine on Joinery World.

lines.line: 옛 관측자는 뒤에 누가 올 줄 알고 장치를 손질해 두었다.

text.line: The old watchers knew someone would come after them, and kept the machines in repair.

pages.art: Quiet close view: three small gloved hands of the brothers rest on a row of polished brass levers set at exactly their height. Old oil cans and neat tools hang on the wall beside them, as if someone has just tidied up. Warm lamplight.

lines.line: 레버를 당기면 한쪽 벽이 열리고 다른 쪽이 닫혔다.

text.line: Pull a lever and one wall opens while another closes.

lines.line: 하나를 얻으려면 하나를 내려놓아야 했다.

text.line: To gain one way, we had to let another go.

pages.art: Inside a planet of wooden joinery and brass: the middle brother pulls a brass lever; on the left a timber wall swings open with light, on the right another one swings shut. The other brothers watch from the doorway.

rule.line: 자루의 첫 별이 다시 켜졌다. 일곱 중 다섯.

text.line: The first star of the handle is lit again: five of seven.

lines.line: 새 선을 따라 큰 축이 금 간 행성을 가리켰다.

text.line: Along the new line, the great axle pointed at a cracked planet.

lines.line: 여섯째 별은 거의 꺼져, 그 땅은 한 번만 버틴다.

text.line: The sixth star is nearly out, and its ground holds only once.

lines.line: 더 늦기 전에 건너야 한다.

text.line: We must cross before it is too late.

pages.art: A huge wooden-and-brass axle at the top of the joinery planet, still now, points like a hand at a grey planet webbed with cracks floating in the night. The three brothers stand on the axle's base beside a pulled brass lever, tiny against it.

lines.line: 무너지는 행성을 끝까지 건넜다.

text.line: We crossed Crumbling World to its end.

lines.line: 지나온 길은 뒤에서 모두 무너졌다.

text.line: Every path behind us fell away.

pages.art: On a crumbling grey planet, a path of cracked stone tiles: behind the youngest brother the tiles break away into starry darkness, but one tile he crossed has set into smooth, solid, softly glowing stone for those behind.

lines.line: 선돌을 세는 문 앞에서, 큰형은 남지 않고 지도만 건넸다.

text.line: At the stone-counting gate, our eldest handed on just the map instead of staying.

lines.line: 남지 않고 건네는 것도 길을 지키는 일이었다.

text.line: Handing on the map without staying was a way of keeping the path, too.

pages.art: In front of a heavy stone gate with a row of empty round sockets (it opens for standing stones), the eldest brother (teal scarf) holds out the glowing scroll to the middle brother (ochre scarf) with both hands, and begins to dissolve into a ribbon of starlight. Calm and warm, not sad. No standing stone in this picture.

rule.line: 자루의 둘째 별이 다시 켜졌다. 일곱 중 여섯.

text.line: The second star of the handle is lit again: six of seven.

lines.line: 부서진 조각들이 떠올라 늪 위에 디딤돌을 놓았다.

text.line: The broken pieces rose and laid stepping stones across the bog.

lines.line: 그 끝, 일곱째 별 아래에 선돌의 원이 있다.

text.line: At the end, under the seventh star, stands the ring of stones.

lines.line: 원을 맞출 단 하룻밤이 다가온다.

text.line: The one night the circle can align is coming.

pages.art: Wide view: fragments of the crumbling planet float up and settle as a line of stepping stones over a dark mossy bog. At the far end, on a low hill, a ring of plain grey standing stones under the dipper, whose handle tip leans toward it.

lines.line: 원형 제단의 늪을 헤치고 나왔다.

text.line: We waded out of the bog of The Stone Circle.

lines.line: 원의 선돌마다 일곱 행성의 셈이 새겨져 있었다.

text.line: Every stone of the circle bore the counts of all seven planets.

pages.art: The three brothers wade slowly through a dark mossy bog, mud up to their knees, the youngest carrying the scroll high. Ahead, on a low hill, the ring of plain grey standing stones waits under the night sky; behind them their deep footprints fill with starlight.

lines.line: 배운 것을 모두 합쳐서야 원 한가운데에 닿았다.

text.line: Only by using all we had learned did we reach the circle's heart.

lines.line: 자루 끝 별이 깨어나기 시작했다.

text.line: The star at the tip of the handle began to wake.

lines.line: 머리 위에는 움직이지 않는 별이 있었다.

text.line: Overhead hung the still star.

pages.art: Low view from inside the stone circle looking up: on each grey stone seven small simple carved marks (abstract shapes, no letters) glow faintly; overhead one bright still star, with the whole dipper wheeling around it, the tip of its handle almost touching the circle's edge. The three brothers' hooded silhouettes at the bottom edge.

rule.line: 일곱 중 여섯은 켜졌다. 마지막 별은 원 한가운데서 켜진다.

text.line: Six of seven are lit. The last star lights at the heart of the circle.

lines.line: 오늘이 그 밤, 자루 끝이 움직이지 않는 별 아래 선다.

text.line: Tonight is that night: the tip of the handle stands under the still star.

lines.line: 셋이 함께, 마지막 일곱 걸음을 센다.

text.line: Together, the three of us count out the last seven steps.

pages.art: The three brothers stand side by side at the edge of the circle, holding scarf ends, ready to step in. In front of them seven faint star marks wait on the ground leading to the centre stone. Hushed, hopeful.

rule.line: 원은 이 바퀴의 단 하룻밤에만 맞춰진다.

text.line: The circle aligns only on this one night of the turn.
